jobs.description:
– join MUNTHE’s creative team in Copenhagen

MUNTHE is a heritage brand that blends fashion with art. Founded in Copenhagen in 1994 by Creative Director Naja Munthe as an artistic and craft-focused alternative to the contemporary fashion industry, it has grown into an established Danish fashion house.

Art and craftsmanship are at the heart of MUNTHE’s collections. Prints play an important role in the brand’s design language, alongside carefully chosen fabrics, feminine silhouettes and attention to detail.

MUNTHE is looking for a Print Designer to join its creative team in Copenhagen and help develop the prints that are central to the brand’s identity.

MUNTHE has built a strong international presence and continues to grow from its Copenhagen headquarters.

THE ROLE

You have 3+ years of experience as a print designer in the fashion or textile industry and have worked with both digital and screen printing. You bring a strong eye for colour, composition and texture, along with a sound understanding of print production.

A bachelor’s or master’s degree from the Royal Danish Academy, Design School Kolding or a similar institution is an advantage.

PROFESSIONAL SKILLS

• Strong drawing skills, including fine line work across different media.
• Proficiency in Illustrator and Photoshop for developing prints, repeats and production-ready artwork.
• An understanding of fashion and how prints work within a collection.
• Experience with AI-powered creative tools to support research, concept exploration and print development.
• Curiosity about new print techniques, creative tools and emerging technologies.
PERSONAL PROFILE

• An organised and structured approach to your work.
• Curiosity and passion for print development.
• Energy, initiative and a positive outlook.
• The flexibility to manage several projects and changing priorities.
• A dependable approach and attention to deadlines and detail.
• A collaborative mindset and a willingness to share ideas.
• A genuine interest in contributing to MUNTHE’s creative development.
RESPONSIBILITIES

• Developing original prints for MUNTHE’s collections.
• Creating print repeats and exploring colour combinations.
• Working closely with the design and production teams to develop prints from initial idea to final artwork.
• Preparing artwork and technical files for production.
• Reviewing and commenting on print strike-offs.
• Gathering inspiration from art, colour and trends and translating it into prints for the collections.
WE OFFER

• A creative role in an established Danish fashion house.
• A unique opportunity to contribute to the visual identity of an international fashion brand.
• Skilled colleagues and an open, collaborative working environment.
• A salary package that reflects your qualifications and experience.
This is a full-time position at MUNTHE’s headquarters in Copenhagen.

APPLICATION

UnikRecruitment is assisting MUNTHE with the recruitment process. Your identity will not be disclosed to MUNTHE without your prior consent. Please send your CV and application in English. We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Michael Kjærgaard, UnikRecruitment, at +45 2222 4000 or email mk@unikrecruitment.dk.

At Eltronic, the Manufacturing IT team connects production and IT through control systems, automation, and advanced MES solutions. As an intern, you will become part of the team and turn theory into a concrete solution that can be demonstrated in practice.

Your Assignment

You will develop a fully functional Proof of Concept that simulates a production cell. A modern SCADA platform communicates with a simulated PLC via OPC UA and integrates with the MES platform's Web APIs for job management, job response, and production history.

You will have the opportunity to work with:

• Setting up a simulated PLC and OPC UA server with process data, machine status, and cycle times

• SCADA integration for data collection, events, and production monitoring

• Development of a modern web-based operator interface

• REST/JSON integration with MES, enabling active and upcoming jobs to be displayed and started

• Documentation and evaluation of architecture, data flow, API calls, and best practices

We Imagine That You

Are studying Automation Engineering, Computer Technology, IT, Marine Engineering, or a similar field, and are curious about industrial communication, software development, APIs, and databases.

Experience with OPC UA or SCADA/HMI is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who is motivated by the assignment and eager to learn.

What We Offer

An exciting internship with hands-on experience in enterprise software and modern SCADA architecture, close professional sparring with colleagues, and the opportunity to influence both the solution and its documentation.

As an intern, you will have your own workspace and become part of our strong community, which also includes other interns.

About Eltronic A/S

Eltronic A/S is an engineering company with more than 25 years of experience in production systems and automation. We develop, deliver, and service automation and production solutions for customers within the food, life sciences, and manufacturing industries. Eltronic employs more than 160 engineers and technicians.

Application & Questions

If you have any questions about the internship, please feel free to contact:

Senior Business Manager, Jannik Munk

Phone: +45 40 44 44 05

E-mail: jmk@eltronic.dk

Please send your application as soon as possible if you would like to join the team. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.

At Eltronic, we seek to promote equality and diversity. Therefore, we encourage everyone to apply for the position regardless of ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, handicap, religion, or age.

Eltronic automates, digitalizes, and optimizes production systems and processes. We specialize in facilitating efficient, straightforward, and sustainable production. Relying on our expertise and broad industry knowledge, we have developed and delivered automated production solutions since 2000.

We have all competencies to carry out complete projects in-house – from consulting and concept to production and installation. Our clients are large industrial companies, and in every project, our goal is to hand over an individualized solution that adds value to our customer’s business.

Knowledge is the very backbone of Eltronic, and today we employ more than 300 engineers, technicians, project managers, and professionals. Our employees are our most valuable asset, and we support them in growing and learning throughout their careers at Eltronic.

Eltronic A/S is part of Eltronic Group A/S

• Experience as a consultant will be regarded as a plus but is not decisive.

• A commercial mindset, with some experience in sales or business development.

THERE ARE PLENTY OF ATTRACTIVE REASONS FOR JOINING FORCES WITH US:

• The possibility of taking on a senior position as Principal Consultant, Director or Associated Partner depending on experience. No matter the entry title, we will support you in your professional development to take the next steps in your career with us.

• The possibility of transferring industry experience into a role of advisory and consulting.

• Becoming part of a new, modern, and growing company with a great opportunity to influence the journey (ways of working, toolbox, processes, our culture etc.).

• Being able to choose your own leader. And choose another, if you don’t feel the right chemistry and support.

• Having a balanced consulting life, where flexibility, trust and focus on work-life balance is regarded as key (your colleagues also have kids, want to go on vacation or just relax).

All of this will be supported by a competitive package that rewards your expertise and dedication.

Naturally, we also offer daily sweet benefits such as a centrally located office, lunch at Restaurant “Herkomst”, health insurance, great coffee and not least plenty of social gatherings with your future work buddies.

We welcome diversity

At Unify Partners, we believe that diversity is our strength. We value the unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences that each individual brings to the table. Our commitment to inclusivity extends beyond mere words - it’s woven into the fabric of our company culture and our strategic objectives.

We invite everyone to apply for this position, regardless of ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or other characteristics.

Ready to join us? Submit your application via the link below.

Please be aware, that due to summer vacation, all applications will be read and replied to after 5th of August.

We expect to plan for interviews in August and September.

We look forward to learning more about you!

ABOUT US

Unify Partners is a management consulting firm helping clients unify business and technology. Within approximately two years, we have grown to 30 colleagues and work with mid-size to big companies whenever they need help within our capabilities. This could be vendor selection, ERP transformation, implementation support, data governance, AI, operational excellence/supply chain excellence etc.

Unifying business and technology is what we do.

Founded by experienced partners, we have established a solid foundation for growth from the very outset. The ambitions of Unify Partners are to expand substantially in the years to come by offering great client value just as a balanced and great work-life (or just life) to our competent team.

We believe that the key to delivering better results lies in unifying various skills and perspectives. Therefore, our culture revolves around bringing diverse people together, and by uniting our expertise, we deliver the best solutions alongside our external partners. We call it "The power of together".

Our values mirror the fundamentals of our culture: being a workplace, where outstanding customer projects is balanced with personal- and professional growth and work-life balance. To live these values, we prioritise training, knowledge sharing, workshops, just as internal teambuilding, and social events. For more information about the social life in Unify Partners, we refer to our Instagram: @Unifypartners.

If you are interested in joining us, please apply today. We promise you that you will become a part of a fast-paced and fun workplace!

jobs.occupation: Post Doc in quantum optics and quantum information
jobs.description:
A 2-year post doc position is available in the theoretical quantum optics group at the Niels Bohr Institute, University of Copenhagen. The position will be part of the quantum internet alliance, which is a European project aiming at building large-scale quantum networks. The post doc will participate in designing and modelling the prototype quantum internet that is scheduled to be built at the end of the project. Additionally, the post doc may work on general theory of quantum repeaters and quantum networks as well as ongoing research on generating narrow band single photons in collaboration with the experimental activities at the Niels Bohr Institute. 

  The postdoc’s duties will include research within theoretical quantum options and quantum information. The post may also include performance of other duties.

  Further information on the Department is linked at http://www.science.ku.dk/english/about-the-faculty/organisation/. Inquiries about the position can be made to Professor Anders S. Sørensen anders.sorensen@nbi.ku.dk

  The position is open from 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

   

  Terms of employment

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

   

  Please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent) 	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers    

  The deadline for applications is 9 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. 

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. 

   

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held starting December.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in High-Speed Hyperspectral and Super-Resolution Terahertz Imaging - DTU Electro
jobs.description:
Are you interested in pushing terahertz (THz) imaging beyond today’s limits in speed, bandwidth, and spatial resolution? 

At DTU Electro, you will work at the interface of ultrafast THz photonics, nonlinear optical detection, coherent imaging, and machine learning to develop a new generation of high-speed hyperspectral THz imaging technology.

The PhD project is part of the DFF-funded INSPIRING project (High-speed hyperspectral and super-resolution terahertz imaging). INSPIRING will combine broadband THz-to-near-infrared upconversion with CMOS-array detection to enable high-speed THz imaging. Your main role will be to establish the imaging platform and develop hyperspectral and machine-learning methods for super-resolution imaging and material identification.

You will work in an international, interdisciplinary team at DTU Electro. The project includes a planned 3–6-month research stay in Prof. Xi-Cheng Zhang’s group at the University of Rochester, USA.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your research will focus on high-speed coherent THz imaging with machine learning. 

You will:

• Develop and operate a broadband coherent THz imaging platform using optical rectification and/or laser-induced plasma THz sources.
• Implement wide-field imaging based on THz-to-NIR upconversion and CMOS focal-plane-array detection.
• Acquire and analyze time-domain hyperspectral THz data with a target bandwidth above 10 THz.
• Apply machine-learning methods, including CNN and autoencoder-type architectures, for super-resolution reconstruction and material identification.
• Study semiconductors, polymers, multilayer structures, and industrial test samples, and collaborate with project partners in Denmark and abroad. 
• Publish your results in peer-reviewed journals and present them at international conferences.
We are looking for a highly motivated and curious candidate with a strong background in experimental photonics, optics, applied physics, electrical engineering, or a closely related field. Experience with THz spectroscopy, ultrafast laser systems, nonlinear optics, or optical imaging is highly desirable. Experience with scientific programming, data analysis, image processing, or machine learning will be considered an advantage. You should have a strong interest in experimental research and be comfortable working with complex optical setups as well as analyzing large multidimensional datasets. We value creativity, independent problem-solving, and the ability to work effectively in an interdisciplinary and international research environment. You should also have good communication skills and be able to present and communicate your scientific results clearly in written and spoken English.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applicants will be made by Associate Professor Binbin Zhou, Professor Peter Uhd Jepsen, and Associate Professor Francesco Da Ros. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. 

The period of employment is 3 years. The start date is 1 January 2027 (or by mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Binbin Zhou at zhou@dtu.dk. 

You can read more about DTU Electro at www.electro.dtu.dk. 

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 30 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Electro  
DTU Electro employs more than 300 skilled researchers with competencies in electrical and photonics engineering. As a department, we strive towards creating sustainable energy and a greener internet, as well as strengthening cyber security and health technology. Working with industry and public organizations is one of our top priorities to find and implement new solutions to our society. We aim to offer education, research, and innovation of the highest standard, and our focus on application-oriented research enables us to work across many engineering disciplines and research areas, such as IT and the medical and health sciences. We have a close collaboration with researchers from all over the world, just as we collaborate with industry and public authorities about the dissemination of solutions based on electrical and photonics engineering as their key enabling technologies. 

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Picture your typical week: on Monday you’re on-site at a pharmaceutical client, leading a cross-functional team through a critical MES go-live. By Wednesday you’re working with the IT leadership to turn your delivery results into a business case for the next phase. Friday, you’re back at Emendo’s Nordhavn office sharing what you learned and sharpening the methods your colleagues will use on their projects. If that sounds like work you’d love, keep reading.

Why We’re Hiring Now

We paused hiring over the past year to be deliberate about the team we build next. The consulting market in Denmark has tightened, and our clients have changed how they buy: they want fewer consultants with more experience, people who can walk into a complex situation and show measurable progress within weeks, not months. We are now making a small number of senior hires — each one matters, and we are taking the time to find the right people.

About Emendo

Emendo is a 200-person consultancy built by people who used to sit on the client side — running transformation programmes inside pharma before deciding to do it for a living. We understand the pressure a site director feels before a go-live, we know what an inspector looks for, and we speak the language of the people who operate the systems we implement. We work across the full pharmaceutical value chain from R&D through shipping, with offices in Copenhagen, Kalundborg, Odense, Silkeborg, Munich, and Raleigh (USA). Our strategy is simple: deliver faster, prove value in hard numbers, and use our methods and AI tools to do what we do well — only quicker.

We are a methods-driven firm rooted in operational excellence and Lean. Our motto, Observe, Think, Improve, is itself a method: go to the floor, understand what is actually happening, analyse it rigorously, then design and implement a concrete improvement. That simplicity is what makes it reliable when the project gets complicated and the usual playbooks stop working.

The Role

You will lead IT/OT transformation engagements for clients in pharma and regulated industries — operating at the intersection of technology, business process, and organisational change. You are expected to create measurable impact from the outset, build trusted relationships with client stakeholders, and identify opportunities to expand Emendo’s footprint within your accounts. At Emendo, seniority means more than years served: it means sound judgement in ambiguity, credibility with demanding stakeholders, and the willingness to raise the standard of the whole team.

What You Will Do

• Lead client engagements on-site, owning delivery of IT/OT implementations across enterprise, operations management, process control, and process equipment layers

• Drive measurable progress in short cycles — the kind your client’s leadership can point to in a steering committee: cost reduced, lead time shortened, risk closed out

• Manage project governance, solution architecture alignment, and validation concepts within complex, multi-stakeholder environments

• Shape how Emendo works — contribute to our methods, package what you learn into repeatable offerings and case studies, and use AI tools to deliver faster without cutting corners

• Build lasting client relationships — become a trusted partner to your stakeholders, spot opportunities for follow-on work, and contribute to Emendo’s business development by turning strong delivery into new engagements

• Apply Observe, Think, Improve as your foundation — and mentor junior colleagues to do the same

What It Takes

Must-Have Qualifications

• Master’s degree in engineering, IT, or a related discipline

• 6–10+ years of hands-on delivery experience in IT/OT project management, product ownership, or solution implementation — ideally within pharma or other regulated industries, though strong candidates from adjacent sectors are welcome

• Track record of delivering quantifiable business outcomes (cost reduction, lead-time improvement, risk mitigation) — not just on-time/on-budget projects

• Strong command of project governance, stakeholder management, and the ability to engage credibly with C-suite and senior client leadership

• Deep understanding of at least one area: enterprise systems (ERP/MES), process control, IT–OT convergence, or value chain technology

• Fluent English, both written and spoken; Danish skills are strongly preferred, or a commitment to learn

• Willingness to work on-site at client locations in Denmark and occasionally internationally

Nice to have — but not required

None of the following are dealbreakers. If you tick even one or two, it tells us you will ramp up faster — but we have seen great consultants arrive without any of them and build the expertise here.

• Experience with GxP compliance, computer system validation (CSV/CSA), or regulatory frameworks in life sciences

• Familiarity with AI/automation tools applied to enterprise transformation or operational settings

• Background in operational excellence, Lean, or continuous improvement methodologies

• Experience working across multiple sites or geographies in global transformation programmes

• Comfort with outcome-based or fixed-price engagement models

What Makes Emendo Different

• Measured on outcomes, not utilisation — you work directly with industry leaders on engagements that matter

• One integrated firm with deep methods: cross-unit collaboration across Implementation, Engineering, Digital, and R&D, backed by a Lean toolbox and AI accelerators

• Freedom under responsibility — challenging projects with room to shape the solution and your own career

• A flat culture where your input matters and your wins are celebrated

• Competitive compensation reflecting the seniority and impact expected in this role

This role is probably not for you if:

• You prefer purely advisory work with limited implementation responsibility.

• You work best with narrow ownership and very clear boundaries.

• You have strong technical exposure but limited experience leading cross-functional change.

Ready to Make an Impact?

We are hiring two to three Senior Consultants this year. Each one joins a team that has led some of the largest IT/OT programmes in US and European pharma — people who chose Emendo because they wanted senior-level impact in a firm that still feels personal. If that resonates, we’d like to hear from you.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We will be in touch promptly.

For further information, reach out to Mikael Elley (me@emendo.com or +45 24 83 62 01).

Join LOCA – gastronomy, hospitality and sustainability

LOCA Group is looking for talented and passionate Chefs and Sous Chefs to join our restaurants in Copenhagen.
At LOCA, we work with something we believe is one of the most important things in the world: the meal. We believe gastronomy can help create a better future, and every day we work to combine high gastronomic standards, genuine hospitality and concrete sustainable choices. 
For us, sustainability starts with the ingredient. We work with seasonal produce, high levels of organic ingredients, local producers and reducing food waste. 
We want to raise the bar for how sustainability is approached in gastronomy – without compromising flavour or the guest experience.

We are looking for Chefs and Sous ChefsWe are looking for both experienced Chefs and Sous Chefs who want to become part of our different kitchens.We are looking for people who:

• 
Are trained Chefs or have equivalent relevant experience

• 
Have experience from professional kitchens with high gastronomic standards.

• 
Work in a structured way and remain calm and focused during service.

• 
Have strong culinary skills and a genuine passion for gastronomy.

• 
Enjoy teamwork and contribute positively to the kitchen environment.

• 
Are curious and motivated to develop both professionally and personally.

• 
Have an interest in sustainability, organic ingredients, seasonal produce and local producers.

• 
For Sous Chef positions, you should also have experience with leadership, planning, ordering, food safety and the daily operation of a professional kitchen.

We value respect, collaboration, responsibility and the desire to keep improving.

Our restaurants

As part of LOCA, you will have the opportunity to work in different gastronomic environments:

Amélie – The Opera House
A modern Danish brasserie where classic French techniques meet Danish ingredients and the unique atmosphere of the Opera House. The kitchen works across à la carte, opera service and larger events
.PAULA – Carlsberg Byen
A modern French-Japanese kitchen focusing on deep umami, precision, seasonal ingredients and a minimum of 60% organic produce. A small, focused team with high gastronomic ambitions.
DOLORES – Carlsberg Byen
A vibrant restaurant inspired by San Francisco’s Mission District, serving creative sharing-style dishes with seasonal ingredients in a relaxed atmosphere.
Restaurant RADIO – Frederiksberg
A modern Nordic restaurant with more than 15 years of history. The restaurant focuses on organic and seasonal ingredients, local producers, vegetables and fish from Nordic waters.LOCA also operates
Kilden i Haven in Tivoli and several canteens.

What we offer

• 
A workplace with high gastronomic ambitions.

• 
An international and diverse working environment.

• 
Passionate and dedicated colleagues.

• 
Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• 
Responsibility and influence in your daily work.

• 
Opportunities for further training and development within LOCA.

• 
Salary and employment conditions based on qualifications.

• 
The opportunity to become part of a company actively working to shape the future of sustainable gastronomy.

Why LOCA?We believe the best restaurants are created by people who want to succeed together.At LOCA, you are not simply joining a kitchen. You become part of a community where we share knowledge, support each other and work together to create great meals and great workplaces.We believe Every Meal Matters – and that the choices we make today help create a better world tomorrow.Practical information

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Employment: Full-time

Positions: Chef / Sous Chef

Start: By agreement / as soon as possible

Salary: Based on qualifications

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.
If you would like to join LOCA, please send your CV and application telling us a little about yourself, your experience and why you would like to work with us.Send your resume to job@locarestauranter.dk

jobs.occupation: Are you our new GTM Engineer?
jobs.description:
About the Role

In this cross-functional, individual-contributor role, you will build, operate, and iterate Accutics' GTM revenue system across the entire sales lifecycle: Accounts → contacts → signals → outreach → meetings → pipeline → revenue → expansion.

You will not only be responsible for filling the funnel; you will own the systems, data, routing, and operational efficiency to ensure a seamless handoff, maximum conversion velocity, and a reliable path from activity to revenue using a modern GTM stack (Clay, Claude Code/Codex, Instantly, HeyReach, ...).

You will work side-by-side with our AEs, Product Marketer, and CPO, and report directly to the CEO. This is a hands-on role for a technical self-starter who builds things themselves, takes ownership, experiments quickly, and turns successful tests into production systems.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead Generation & Demand Capture: Build, operate, and iterate targeted, multi-channel campaigns across outbound, ABM, and account expansion to generate qualified meetings, pipeline, and revenue. Build account/contact lists, enrich prospects, identify signals, and activate contacts through appropriate channels.

• Sales Enablement & Alignment: Act as a GTM systems partner to the sales team. Deliver well-qualified accounts and contacts equipped with deep contextual data, signals, and account intelligence. Onboard sales reps into workflows and ensure system transparency so it saves them time rather than becoming a black box.

• AI-Supported Revenue Operations: Build and operate the GTM technology and data stack. Build robust enrichment, scoring, routing, synchronization, and automation workflows.

• Market & Persona Strategy: Translate ICP, enterprise account, and persona strategies into repeatable GTM workflows and continuously iterate based on performance.

• Flawless Tracking: “Drink our own champagne.” Utilize the Accutics platform internally to guarantee that our own campaign tracking, naming conventions, and metadata are perfectly structured from the point of creation. Maintain high-quality GTM and CRM data so pipeline and revenue can be reliably measured.

• Full-Funnel Analytics: Monitor the GTM system and its commercial performance from initial account targeting through closed-won revenue and account expansion. Identify bottlenecks and build solutions to fix them.

What We Are Looking For

Required:

· Enterprise GTM Execution: 1–3 years of hands-on experience in GTM Engineering, GTM Operations, or RevOps, preferably in GTM agency or B2B SaaS. Proven track record taking outbound, ABM, and expansion campaigns from concept to production.

· GTM Engineering & Data: Hands-on experience with Clay (including Function and Workflow capabilities), bidirectional CRM sync with Salesforce, APIs, webhooks, and automation workflow logic.

· AI / Agentic GTM: Experience experimenting with and deploying production multi-agent GTM systems built with Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools.

· Working Style: Highly autonomous, operationally disciplined, and commercially minded, measuring success by quality pipeline and revenue, not top-of-funnel metrics.

A Plus:

· Experience with GTM tools such as email and LinkedIn sequencers, unified inboxes, email infrastructure, enrichment, intent/signal, LinkedIn social warming, call dialer.

· Experience building other GTM workflows: account expansion/ churn/ partner sales/ inbound flywheel.

· Experience building Salesforce CRM data foundation, CRM data cleaning routines for modern GTM.

· Comfortable handling SQL, Agent loops.

What We Offer

· Ownership: Build, operate, and iterate Accutics' new GTM revenue system across the sales lifecycle.

· Modern Stack: Hands-on experience with Clay, Claude Code/Codex, Instantly, HeyReach, ...

· Commercial Impact: Direct impact on pipeline generation, deal velocity, and revenue while returning time to sales teams.

· Agile Environment: Small, international SaaS team with high autonomy, short decision paths, and direct leadership access.

· Copenhagen Office: Central Copenhagen location, Nordic work-life balance, flexible hours, and regular social events.

· Package: Permanent full-time position, competitive salary, pension, and benefits.

Requirements

• You have a valid work permit to work in Europe (Denmark).

• You are fluent in English, both verbally and in writing.

• You are located in the Greater Copenhagen Area (Denmark) or will be relocating here.

Hiring Process

1. GTM Builder Interview: Meet a GTM builder and demonstrate systems you have built and deployed.

2. CEO Interview: Discuss Accutics, the role, and how you will shape the GTM engine.

3. Build Together Session: Collaboratively solve a real GTM challenge to demonstrate your build and testing approach.

What Success Looks Like (3-6 Months)

· Take full build and iteration responsibility for Accutics' GTM revenue system.

· Establish and run daily operational routines, onboarding sales reps to maintain workflow transparency.

· Bring the Salesforce data foundation up to the standard of your new GTM system.

· Continuously test new tools, workflows, and solutions to eliminate sales friction and deliver quality pipeline and revenue.

About Accutics

Accutics is a Copenhagen-based B2B SaaS company providing the ultimate data foundation for global enterprise marketing. We work with the world’s leading brands. Our platform standardizes campaign tracking, governs taxonomy, and ensures data is AI-ready, eliminating manual QA loops for confident, data-informed decisions.

Proud of our Nordic roots, we combine deep domain expertise with close collaboration. We are a small, international team looking for a GTM Engineer to build, operate, and continuously improve a modern, AI-native revenue system across the entire funnel.

How to Apply

Think you’re the right fit? Apply today by submitting your resume and a brief cover letter. You can email it to careers@accutics.com.

Would you like to help build and develop the platform that makes it easier for Whiteaway’s software Engineers to develop, deploy and run their solutions?

Whiteaway Group is looking for a skilled Platform Engineer to join their Platform Squad in Aarhus.

As a Platform Engineer, you will become part of a strong technical environment focused on building and continuously improving the platform used by Whiteaway’s development teams in their daily work.

This is not traditional IT operations. Instead, the focus is on creating automated, stable and scalable solutions that make it easier for Engineers to develop, deploy and run their software.

Whiteaway is a digital-first company where technology plays a central role in the business. The company operates some of the largest online stores in the Nordics within electronics and home appliances, and its technical platforms are an important part of the continued development of the business.

Your role

You will play a central role in developing and improving Whiteaway’sinternal platform and will work closely with software Engineers and the other members of the Platform Squad.

A key part of the role is the close collaboration with Engineers. You will be curious about how they work, understand their needs and challenges, and use their feedback to identify how workflows, processes and platform tooling can be made simpler, faster and better.

Over the coming years, Whiteaway will be taking the platform to a significantly higher level. A key focus will be reducing and removing legacy and building a more modern, scalable and developer-friendly platform. AI will also play an increasingly important role in how the platform develops and how Whiteaway’s Engineers work.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing and continuously improving the cloud platform

• Automating deployment and development processes

• Infrastructure as Code

• CI/CD pipelines

• Containerisation and Kubernetes

• Cloud infrastructure – primarily AWS

• Monitoring, observability and reliability

• Engineering tooling and self-service solutions

• Security and access management

• Troubleshooting and optimising platform performance and stability

The role offers a high degree of freedom, and you will have the opportunity to take ownership and influence both the technology and the way the team works.

Whiteaway believes in freedom under responsibility. You will have the opportunity to take ownership, influence technical decisions and help shape both the platform and the way the team works.

We imagine that you…

You have a strong technical background and experience within software development, cloud, DevOps or platform engineering. Perhaps you are already working as a Platform Engineer, Cloud Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer or Senior Software Engineer with strong cloud and infrastructure experience.

Your title is less important than your motivation to work hands-on with platform engineering and your ability to thrive at the intersection of software development, cloud and operations. Experience with general software development is an advantage, particularly Node.js and/or Go.

We would like you to have experience with several of the following technologies and tools:

• AWS

• Kubernetes

• Docker

• Terraform / Infrastructure as Code

• CI/CD

• Git/GitHub

• Linux

• Node.js and/or Go

• Datadog

• ArgoCD

• Spacelift

• Cloudflare

• Monitoring and observability

• Networking and cloud infrastructure

Experience with GitOps is an advantage, but not a requirement. Experience with security or with the intersection between operations and software development is also considered an advantage.

You do not need to know everything. What matters most is that you have strong technical curiosity, can understand complex problems and are motivated to continuously improve the way things are done.

Your professional development is important to Whiteaway.

You will have the opportunity to work with development plans, strengthen your technical skills and take your expertise to the next level. At the same time, knowledge sharing is an important part of the culture – you are expected not only to develop yourself, but also to help lift others around you.

On a personal level, drive, determination and humility are highly valued. You take ownership and get things done, while remaining curious, collaborative and motivated to find the best solutions together with others.

What Whiteaway offers

At Whiteaway, you will be part of an informal, inclusive and supportive leadership culture where Engineers have real ownership and the opportunity to influence their work. The culture is built around experimentation, knowledge sharing and continuous learning, with opportunities to take part in hackathons, pair programming and MOB programming, as well as access to learning resources.

The social side of working together is also important. People at Whiteaway genuinely enjoy working together, and there is a strong focus on building good relationships across the team. Through activities such as hackathons, Improvement Mondays and other social initiatives, there are plenty of opportunities to come together, share knowledge, experiment and have fun.

Whiteaway also values a healthy work-life balance, a great lunch and good colleagues. The office is located in Skejby, with free parking.

About Whiteaway Group

Whiteaway Group is a tribe of 300+ passionate people working across Scandinavia, selling and shipping appliances through e-commerce, franchise stores and B2B channels.

Around 250 employees are based at the headquarters in Aarhus, covering the group’s central functions. Around 45 people work within Tech across IT, Engineering and Product. The Platform Squad currently consists of four Platform Engineers, and the team is expected to grow in the coming years as the demands on and use of the platform continue to increase – including with the growing use of AI.

With brands like Skousen, Tretti and Whiteaway, the group is grounded in innovation and honesty, always pushing for better customer experiences through technology.

Interested in joining Whiteaway Group?

Bloom is handling the recruitment process on behalf of Whiteaway Group and is actively reviewing applications. We look forward to receiving your application and CV in Danish or English as soon as possible.

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact IT Recruitment Manager Dorte Pape at Bloom at dp@bloom.dk or on +45 3160 9365.

From high-energy arena shows and studio broadcasts to digital content that sets new standards, we bring the biggest moments in esports to life - working with top-tier partners like Valve, Riot Games, Epic Games, Ubisoft, Krafton, and more.

Building AI keeps getting cheaper and faster. Deciding what's worth building, and getting an organisation to actually commit to it, does not.

At Heyra, we build AI systems, workflows and data platforms that are meant to live in production from day one. We work closely with companies that are moving quickly and need a partner who can hold both the strategic picture and the delivery reality in one head.

We're looking for a Deployment Strategist: the person the client's leadership talks to. You own the relationship and the outcome. You sit with a C-suite buyer, understand where their business is actually trying to go, and translate that into a sharp, sequenced plan for what we build and why. Then you steer a strong engineering team to make it real - without being the one in the codebase.

This is the strategic counterpart to our engineers. Where they go deep into the build, you hold the commercial and strategic frame: what problem are we really solving, what impact are we creating, in what order, and how do we get the organisation to adopt it. You're more product manager than a traditional consultant, with a strong strategic angle - closer to an Engagement Manager who's technical enough to make the right calls than a slide-deck advisor.

You'll work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists and designers in a company where ideas move quickly and the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

What you'll work on

• 
Owning client relationships at the leadership level - being the person the C-suite trusts

• 
Framing the real problem behind the ask, and shaping it into an engagement worth running together with our FDEs

• 
Sequencing what gets built, in what order, and being accountable for the business value - not just the artifact

• 
Steering engineering teams toward outcomes, translating in both directions between the client and the builders

• 
Driving adoption: managing expectations, working with the people who have to live with the solution, and staying through the part after launch

• 
Scoping, structuring and de-risking engagements as they evolve

• 
Spotting where the next opportunity sits inside an account and growing it

Requirements

You probably have experience with

• 
Management consulting, change management, adoption, implementation of AI-native solutions.

• 
Owning client or stakeholder relationships end to end, with real accountability for outcomes

• 
Product, programme or engagement leadership in a technical environment

• 
Being technically literate - fluent enough in data and AI to make the right calls and earn trust with both buyers and builders, without needing to write the production code yourself

• 
Translating between business strategy and what's actually buildable

• 
Bringing structure to ambiguous, fast-moving situations

• 
The patience to sit with a worried manager, and the stubbornness to stay until adoption actually lands

Curiosity, taste and the way you think matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience. We hire for the who, not the what - experience is an indicator of perspective, not a deciding factor for how senior a role you'll play here. We're hiring across levels and shape the role around the person.

Why Heyra

At Heyra, we believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We're building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build, and operate AI products that change how enterprises work - from problem to prototype to production.

We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high.

You'll join a team where:

• 
people care deeply about what they build

• 
good ideas move quickly

• 
new technology gets explored early

• 
and where there is room to shape both the company and the way we work

We're around 50 people today after merging with Pyne, and we're only just getting started.

If owning how AI engagements get framed, sold and landed at Heyra sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

Benefits

Healthcare insurance

Social gatherings

•

• 
Central office

• 
Free lunch, coffee, snacks, and Friday beers

• 
Skill development

Remote work allowed

• 
Pet friendly

We’re looking for a Legal Engineer to join our Product team in Copenhagen. Someone with a strong legal foundation who is excited about AI, technology, and finding better ways to do legal work. You’ll get hands-on with our product, work on real legal problems, and help us build AI-powered tools that lawyers can actually rely on.

About Pandektes

Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

About the role

As a Legal Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of law, AI, and product. You'll join our Product team and work closely with Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales.

This is a hands-on role: rather than practising law, you'll use your legal expertise to evaluate AI-generated legal work, figure out where and why it falls short, and turn real legal problems into scalable AI-powered workflows. It's a good fit if you like getting deep into legal detail but also enjoy stepping back to ask why something works and how it could work better.

What you'll do

• 
Evaluate and improve legal AI quality: test AI-generated legal research and analysis for correctness, completeness, reasoning, and source selection. Investigate where outputs fall short and turn findings into actionable input for Product and Engineering.

• 
Turn legal problems into AI-powered workflows: break down how lawyers actually perform a task, define what a good outcome looks like, and help develop, test, and refine workflows that solve it at scale.

• 
Bring UK legal expertise into product development: apply your knowledge of UK law, legal sources, and lawyer workflows to how we evaluate and build our products.

• 
Work on complex customer problems: partner with Customer Success and Sales on cases needing deeper legal expertise — understand the underlying problem, shape practical solutions, and feed what you learn back into Product.

• 
Help lawyers work effectively with AI: build workflows and examples that help customers get real value from AI in their legal work, and flag recurring needs that could inform future product decisions.

What you’ll bring

We’re primarily looking for strong legal expertise and judgement. You don’t need a background in engineering, AI, or product development — those are things you can develop in the role.

• 
Advanced legal education or professional legal qualification, with a strong foundation in UK law gained through your education and/or professional training. You should be able to independently research, analyse, and assess UK complex and abstract legal questions.

• 
A couple of years of hands-on legal experience from a law firm, in-house legal team, public institution, or comparable legal environment.

• 
Strong experience with legal research and analysis, and the ability to work independently with complex legal questions and source material.

• 
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess the quality of legal work, identify weaknesses or unsupported conclusions, and explain clearly what could be improved.

Nice to have

You don’t need to tick every box below. These are a plus, not requirements:

• 
Hands-on experience using AI tools for legal work, such as legal research, drafting, contract analysis, or document review.

• 
Familiarity with prompting, LLM evaluations, or systematically testing AI-generated outputs.

• 
Experience with document-heavy or structured legal workflows, such as due diligence, contract review, regulatory analysis, or multi-jurisdictional research.

• 
Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders and translating complex legal needs into practical solutions.

• 
Exposure to product development, user testing, or workflow design.

• 
Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or legal systems, particularly both common-law and civil-law systems.

• 
Basic technical or data literacy, such as structured data, APIs, advanced spreadsheets, or simple scripting.

• 
Additional language skills beyond English.

How we work

We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in our Copenhagen HQ and remotely from Hamburg, Zurich and London. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

What we offer

• 
Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• 
A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• 
25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• 
International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• 
Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• 
Paid parental leave

Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

Legal professionals should be able to stand behind every answer. We build the foundation for that: verified legal data, complete across time and traceable to its source, with research tools built for confident legal judgment. Our vision is clear: to be the leading platform for legal information retrieval, enabling in-depth and accurate legal knowledge in a fast, efficient and user-friendly way using artificial intelligence.

That's why we offer a straightforward pricing model with no setup fees for terminals, no subscription fees, and a flat rate for all card types. It's a breath of fresh air compared to the complicated and confusing pricing structures of our competitors.  What sets Flatpay apart is our dedication. We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our client's evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary? WHAT's THE CULTURE LIKE? Flatpay is a fast-moving, performance-driven environment where people are trusted to take ownership from day one. We value initiative, resilience, and a strong work ethic. Our teams are collaborative and supportive, but we also set clear expectations and hold ourselves accountable to results.  As a growing business, things move quickly. That means you’ll have the opportunity to take on real responsibility early, contribute ideas, and see the impact of your work directly. It also means being comfortable with change, solving problems as they arise, and continuously improving how we operate.  We’re best suited to people who are motivated by challenge, enjoy working towards clear goals, and want to develop in a commercial, high-energy environment. WHY CHOOSE FLATPAY? Flatpay offers the opportunity to take real ownership, develop valuable skills, and grow your career in a fast-moving, ambitious company where performance and initiative are recognised.

About Flatpay

Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

About the job

Flatpay has become one of Europe's fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept card payments in-store.

Our Point of Sale system serves as the central engine of the business. It streamlines the merchant's entire workflow — from order taking, product and inventory management, to payment processing, reporting, and compliance.

Some of the core capabilities include:

• 
Product catalogue: Organizes how they manage their products, categories, modifiers and inventory

• 
Order management: Basket, pricing, discounts, payments and managing tables and long-running orders among groups of customers.

• 
Hardware integrations to barcode scanners, receipt and kitchen/bar printers and our different Mobile-, Premium- and Basic POS devices. No least manage synchronicity across multiple POS systems at shared locations in realtime.

• 
Our reporting suite ensures cash management, end-of-day reports, various sales, turnover, staff, tax and compliance reports that enables merchants to optimize their business and comply with local tax regulations.

As our merchants grow, so does the platform. Every new market introduces new payment methods, fiscal requirements and merchant needs. Every new feature increases the depth and complexity of the product. And with our customer base doubling approximately every six months, the demands on scalability, reliability and performance continue to grow.

This is a hands-on engineering role with significant ownership. You'll influence technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions and solve the engineering challenges that come with building one of Europe's fastest-growing commerce platforms.

What you'll do

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll contribute far beyond implementation. You'll help shape technical direction while remaining deeply involved in building products. You'll work closely with Product, Design and fellow engineers to build software that scales across all dimensions: more merchants, more markets, more capabilities and increasingly sophisticated workflows.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Designing, building and evolving features across our Point of Sale platform platform.

Lead feature and platform initiatives involving multiple engineers, driving delivery from discovery through production

• 
Build APIs, services, and integrations that enable stock, order lifecycle, sales reporting & compliance reporting towards governmental standards of our markets.

• 
Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance

• 
Drive architectural decisions and long-term technical improvements

• 
Improve reliability, observability, performance, and security across the platform

• 
Mentor engineers through coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing

• 
Continuously improving our engineering practices, tooling and development experience

• 
Contribute to testing, operational excellence and contribute to a collaborative team culture

Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

Veo's security surface is unusual. We train models on-premise on dedicated GPU infrastructure, run the product across AWS and GCP, and operate a fleet of tens of thousands of cameras deployed at clubs and venues worldwide. That is a scope most SaaS security engineers never touch: physical devices in the field, heavy on-prem compute, and multi-cloud production, all in one role.

We are forming a Security Enablement Team that makes it easier for every engineering and IT team at Veo to build, ship, and operate secure systems. As the most senior engineer on the team, you will own the technical direction of the platform security, identity, and network security slice, partnering with the teams that own these systems so security is built in from the start. As an enablement function, the team does not run these systems day to day. We build the paved roads, tooling, and patterns that let the owning teams operate securely by default.

You will join during a pivotal moment. We are standing the team up, defining what good looks like across platform security, identity, and network security, and rolling out the first paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, CVE response, CI/CD identity, and a unified internal network across our datacenters (GCP, AWS) and offices (Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen). You'll have direct impact on how 100+ engineers write, review and ship secure systems.

What You Will Do

You will join a focused platform security team and operate as its most senior engineer. Everything below follows the same pattern. We design the paved road, prove it works, and hand it to the team that will own it. We share ownership, pair on complex work, and rotate responsibilities, and we expect this role to set the bar.

• Design and build the paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, and CVE response, running inside the pipelines teams already use, with findings routed to the owners who can fix them under tracked SLAs

• Lead the design, reviews, and tooling for a unified internal network and VPN across GCP, AWS, and our Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen offices, while the team that owns the network keeps running it

• Work with the auth service maintainers on identity and access, including MFA rollouts, removal of shared accounts, and cleanup of long-lived tokens, so the patterns stay theirs to own

• Make workload identity the paved road for CI/CD, using OIDC between GitHub Actions and AWS or GCP, packaged so teams can migrate themselves

• Build audit logging as a shared capability that teams plug into rather than reinvent

• Turn GRC controls into technical implementations, with evidence pipelines that produce auditable output without manual follow-up

• Own the contracting cycle for external penetration tests and build the intake, classification, and tracking system that routes findings to named owners, while the owning teams remediate

• Hand each capability off cleanly, with a runbook, a named owner, and an escalation path, and run office hours where product and platform teams can get a security review or a paved-road question answered

• Mentor the rest of the team and raise the security bar across Builders

As the team matures, you will help shape our multi-environment network architecture, our identity and access patterns, and the long-term security posture of the product.

What You Could Bring

This is a deliberately merged platform security and identity role. You do not need to be world class at both. You likely have several years of production infrastructure and security experience behind you, and you are deep and credible in one of these areas and ready to grow into the other.

That depth tends to show up in several of the following:

• Platform security: you have run vulnerability scanning, CVE management, and image scanning at scale, and you know the operational reality of getting CVEs fixed, beyond standing up the tooling

• Identity and auth: you have worked hands-on inside an auth codebase, rolled out MFA on live systems, and managed token lifecycles in CI/CD with OIDC and workload identity

• Network security at scale: you have designed and run a unified internal network across multiple cloud providers and offices, with a VPN approach that holds up

• Platform-as-product mindset: you have built internal security tooling that other teams chose to adopt, with guard rails built into the tools developers already use and manual review as a last resort, and you gathered feedback and measured the impact

• Infrastructure as Code: strong experience with Terraform, Crossplane, or similar

Nice to have: GitOps tools such as Flux or ArgoCD, Cilium, Kubernetes security at scale, and experience building security into a GRC evidence pipeline.

How We Work

You'll join a Copenhagen-based Security Enablement Team of three engineers plus a manager. We operate as an enablement function: we build shared tooling and golden paths, and we step in for focused, high-leverage missions where no other team is positioned to deliver. We do not run a SOC and we do not carry a security pager.

You'll collaborate regularly with the Platform, Product, IT, Firmware, and GRC teams. We work pragmatically and iterate quickly. This role sets the technical direction for the team's quarterly missions. We document decisions, favor simple solutions where possible, and focus on tooling and platform patterns that help teams move faster with confidence.

If you read that list and matched on three or four items but not all of them, apply anyway. The "deep in one, ready to grow into the other" framing above is not a hedge, it is how we actually hire at this level. We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.
